metas.name: Billie Eilish: Hit Me Hard and Soft - The Tour Live in 3D
metas.description: An accompanying 3D concert film, documenting the Manchester shows and co-directed by Eilish and James Cameron.

metas.name: Desire
metas.description: Lucero lo tiene todo, pero un vacío la empuja al riesgo. Matías, el atractivo entrenador de natación, despierta en ella una obsesión: una relación que amenaza su mundo cuando su hija también se siente atraída por él.

metas.name: Hokum
metas.description: A horror writer visits an Irish inn to scatter his parents' ashes, unaware the property is said to be haunted by a witch.

metas.name: The Devil Wears Prada 2
metas.description: Andy Sachs reunites with Miranda Priestly as they navigate their careers amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing.

metas.name: Swapped
metas.description: A tiny woodland creature and a majestic bird suddenly swap bodies, forcing them to team up to survive the wildest adventure of their lives.

metas.name: Michael
metas.description: The early life of musician Michael Jackson, from the discovery of his talent as the lead of the Jackson Five to the artist whose creative ambition fueled a pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

metas.name: I Swear
metas.description: John Davidson: diagnosed with Tourette's syndrome at a young age which alienated him from his peers, he struggled with a condition few people had witnessed.

metas.name: Fuze
metas.description: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

metas.name: Apex
metas.description: A mountain climber haunted by a fatal decision in Norway retreats to the Australian wilderness for isolation. Her journey turns into a desperate hunt when a deceptive local targets her as his next ritualistic prey in the bush.

metas.name: Over Your Dead Body
metas.description: A dysfunctional married couple retreats to a secluded cabin to repair their relationship, but each secretly plots to murder the other.

metas.name: Amrum
metas.description: In 1945 Amrum Island, 12-year-old Nanning hunts seals, fishes at night, and farms to help feed his family. Life feels idyllic on this windswept isle until peace reveals an unexpected danger closer to home.
